question: How do I apply for a business certificate through the city?

tool_calls.name: web_search

input.input: apply for a business certificate Boston

tool_calls.output:
Here’s how to apply for a City of Boston business certificate (quick steps + official links):

- Official instructions (steps, ID/lease requirements, notarization, in‑person or mail filing). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
- Download/print the business certificate form (fillable PDF). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/March-2025-business-certificate-form.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- Prepare: business name & address (no PO box or virtual address), names/addresses of owners, lease or notarized landlord letter; owner signature must be notarized (Clerk can notarize). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
- Fee: $65 filing fee; payment accepted in person or by check/money order if mailed. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/March-2025-business-certificate-form.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- Submit: City Clerk’s Office, Room 601, 1 City Hall Square, Boston, MA 02201 (hours Mon–Fri 9 a.m.–4 p.m.) — or mail with a self‑addressed stamped envelope. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
- Renewal: certificate must be renewed every four years (late‑fee penalties may apply). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))

Do you want me to open the PDF form for you or draft answers for the form?

answer:
To apply for a business certificate in Boston, you'll need to start by gathering some essential information, including your business name and address, the owners' names and addresses, and either a lease agreement or a notarized letter from your landlord. Ensure that the owner's signature is notarized, a service that the City Clerk can provide.

Next, download the fillable PDF business certificate form and complete it. You'll need to pay a filing fee of $65, which can be made in person or via check/money order if mailed. Submit the completed form to the City Clerk’s Office at Room 601, 1 City Hall Square, Boston, MA 02201, during office hours (Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.), or you can mail it with a self-addressed stamped envelope. Remember, the business certificate must be renewed every four years. For more details, visit the official City of Boston website [here](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai).
